description_en: Queries for the details of databases in a specified PolarDB cluster
description_zh: 查询PolarDB指定集群的数据库详情
name: DescribeDatabases

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database.

You cannot specify multiple database names
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名。

不支持填入多个数据库名称
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of an integer. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值范围为大于0但不超过Integer最大值的整数，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30

50

100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值范围如下：
30
50
100

默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

Account.description_en:
The details of the database accounts.

For PolarDB for MySQL clusters, privileged accounts are not returned
Account.description_zh:
数据库账号信息详情。

当集群为PolarDB MySQL版时，不含高权限账号

AccountName.description_en:
The name of the account.

For PolarDB for MySQL clusters, privileged accounts are not returned
AccountName.description_zh:
账号名称。

当集群为PolarDB MySQL版时，不含高权限账号

AccountPrivilege.description_en:
The permissions of the account. Valid values:

ReadWrite: Read and write.

ReadOnly: Read-only.

DMLOnly: DML only.

DDLOnly: DDL only.

ReadIndex: Read and index
AccountPrivilege.description_zh:
账号权限，取值范围如下：

ReadWrite：读写
ReadOnly：只读 
DMLOnly：只允许DML
DDLOnly：只允许DDL
ReadIndex：只读+索引

AccountStatus.description_en:
The status of the account. Valid values:

Creating: The account is being created.

Available: The account is available.

Deleting: The account is being deleted
AccountStatus.description_zh:
账号状态，取值范围如下： 

Creating：创建中
Available：可用
Deleting：删除中

PrivilegeStatus.description_en:
The authorization status. Valid values:

Empowering: Permissions are being granted.

Empowered: Permissions are granted.

Removing: Permissions are being revoked
PrivilegeStatus.description_zh:
授权状态，取值范围如下： 

Empowering：授权中
Empowered：授权完成
Removing：移除权限中

CharacterSetName.description_en: The character set. For more information, see [Character sets]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99716.html）
CharacterSetName.description_zh: 字符集，详情请参见[字符集表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99716.html）。

DBStatus.description_en:
The status of the database. Valid values:

Creating: The database is being created.

Running: The database is in use.

Deleting: The database is being deleted
DBStatus.description_zh:
数据库状态，取值范围如下： 

Creating：创建中
Running：使用中
Deleting：删除中

Engine.description_en:
The type of the database engine. Valid values:

MySQL

Oracle

PostgreSQL
Engine.description_zh:
数据库引擎类型，取值范围如下：
MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL

MasterID.description_en: The ID of the primary node for the database in a Multi-master Cluster (Database/Table) edition cluster
MasterID.description_zh: 多主集群（库表）版的数据库所对应的主节点ID

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
